scope: read-only evidence reanalysis; no model calls; no historical archive changes; no counterfactual performance claims

E1.evidence_boundary: pilot; cannot identify a general branch-development benefit; validation progress did not reliably transfer to Test

v1.interpretation: No quality or component-effect conclusion is estimable because every job terminated on provider failure before a complete search.

r2.interpretation: No quality or component-effect conclusion is estimable because every job terminated on provider failure before a complete search.

interpretation_limits: This is a single-model TSP14 component screen, not universal or cross-task validation.
Test-gap effects resample data blocks; proposals, instances and model requests are not independent replicates.
Missing and infrastructure-incomplete jobs remain visible and are not replaced.
A negative test-gap contrast favors the factor-on condition; the descriptive intervals are not confirmatory p-values.

offline_mechanism_audit.known_narrative_discrepancy: prior narrative said 112 branch-development events; frozen run records count 113

E2.evidence_boundary: r3 is a 4-block component screen; r1 and r2 stopped on provider failures before usable quality estimates
